race.comment: ADDICTIVE DREAM (2) has the most persuasive recent profile, with two wins from four starts this season and a sound fourth at Leonora last week when near the top of betting. The rise to 1400m asks something, given her two previous attempts around the trip, but the winning rider returns with a claim and her Mingenew win two back keeps her clearly on top. BLOWIN' SMOKE (5) is the danger after a one-length second at Leonora as a well-supported favourite, and his record around 1400m gives him a solid base. LADY COCO (8) comes back from provincial company after racing wide at Geraldton, with her Carnarvon third two back reading well enough to keep her in the winning mix despite the distance query. MYSTERY BULLET (9) gets major weight relief after placing in Open grade at Landor and, third-up, has the right set-up to turn recent improvement into a genuine each-way threat. ONE PUNCH (1) is next best.
